TEDM.status: NEW supplemental experiments; no claim to reconstruct the historical separate-host experiments
TEDM.normalization: per-asset mean and population SD fitted to unique raw training rows including purged training labels only
TEDM.selection: validation ES on 498 exact fold1 origins after every epoch; same initialization seed for LR candidates; no test access during training or selection
TEDM.mean_calibration: after checkpoint/candidate selection; rho in [0.05,1] selected by validation ES with frozen innovations
TEDM.inputs: 126 historical one-period excess log returns for all 32 assets; factor file used only for risk-free-return subtraction when reconstructing labels; no FF5 values, concepts or OHLCV as predictor inputs
TEDM.timer_adapter: official Timer-XL point backbone, six21-day input tokens and5-day output head, retain last output token; training-residual joint paths for scenarios
TEDM.tedm_adapter: official UNet/noise/preconditioner/native stochastic sampler;112denoised positions+13conditioning offset+1padding=126total observed rows;five rollout steps;lastfive outputs;explicit track-major reshape correction
TEDM.tedm_training: official weighted denoising objective on126-row training windows ending at each purged target+5; EMA beta.995 every10updates; Adam betas(.9,.96), no weight decay; native plateau scheduler with100update warmup, factor.9 patience15 threshold.01
TEDM.timer_training: point MSE over5futurereturns; Adam betas(.9,.999), no weight decay; epoch cosine scheduler; last-token task adaptation

numerical_adapter.rule: Only finite-input undefined0/0 cumulative-mean ratios receive neutral scale1; signed nonzero/zero retains original infinity clipping; every finite original clipped result preserved exactly
numerical_adapter.scope: new complete runs from scratch; original failed attempt retained separately; no test access in failed attempt
numerical_adapter.nonfinite_policy: reject nonfinite noise inputs/cumulative means, gradients or model weights; never replace forecast outputs

parallel_seed_execution.result_protocol_hash_semantics: Each unchanged seed result hashes its own seed_S/execution_protocol.json, not this assembled protocol
parallel_seed_execution.copy_mode: compact JSON/CSV plus paired origin losses; full predictions/checkpoints remain in source workers
